messages:
Maria C: Quick heads-up — Splinter model ingest moved to next week (vendor pushed a patch). Need to reassign runbook ownership and get a fast-track license review. Who can pick up runtime stash+perf sweep?
Devon: I can take runtime stash and the staging canary. Will need a short shadow window Thurs morning.
Li: I’ll own perf profiles and quantization checks. Can someone confirm sequence length distribution we expect?
Maria C: Thanks — sequence distribution: mostly 512 token median, ~5% >2k. I pushed a small sample to the catalog PR.
Oliver: I can do the rollout orchestration (canary -> 25% -> 100%). @Devon does Thurs morning work for you?
Devon: Thurs 9–11 PT works. I’ll schedule the canary and leave runbook notes in the splinter manifest.
Sam (legal): Quick note from legal — license looks like Apache-2.0 but there's an extra attribution clause in the vendor README. Need to confirm we can redistribute modified weights. Can @Maria C drop the vendor link?
Maria C: Vendor link: https://vendor.example.com/splinter-repo. I pasted the README excerpt in the PR comments. If legal flags redistribution, we’ll fallback to hosted-only offering.
catalog-bot: Manifest updated: splinter-v1.0.0, owners: Li (perf), Devon (runtime), Oliver (rollout), legal_review: pending. Link: https://catalog.internal/splinter-v1.0.0
Li: For perf sweep I’ll run profiles at batch sizes [1,4,8], seq-lens [128,512,2048], and record p50/p95. Any routing constraints?
Oliver: Prefer hosted then dedicated fallback. Routing policy: hosted -> dedicated if p99 latency > 450ms for 512 seq. Set automatic fallback to quantized variant if latency spike.
Devon: Putting a short checklist in the runbook: smoke tests, kv-cache sanity, kv-eviction smoke, prefix cache opt-in. Copying snippet I’ll use as smoke test: ```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.infer/generate -d '{"model":"splinter-v1","prompt":"hi"}'
```
Sam (legal): I scanned the README — vendor requires attribution in UI only, redistribution clause is permissive with clear attribution. I’ll file a short doc and mark legal_review: approved if we add required text to the attribution block.
Maria C: Awesome — action items: (1) Devon schedule Thurs 9–11 PT canary, (2) Li perf sweep by Wed EOD, (3) Sam finalize attribution text, (4) Oliver prepare rollout policy and fallback. I’ll update catalog manifest and ping infra for quota.
Oliver: Noted. I’ll add the rollout policy and a canary alert if error-rate > 1% for 5m.
Devon: I’ll also open a tiny CR for runtime shape changes (embedding dim align) — pinging @eng-runtime if this looks risky.
Maria C: Thanks all. I’ll close the loop tomorrow after legal doc and perf runs. :thumbsup:
